Heat the oil to 180°C and fry in batches until crisp, then salt.Char the corn cobs on a hot grill or pan, then cut off the kernels.Mix the corn with the tomatoes, coriander, lime juice and salt.Serve the salsa in a bowl with the chips.Pantry stash grilled peaches and honeyTinned peach halves grilled cut side down until caramelised, served warm with honey yoghurt, toasted almonds and a pinch of cinnamon.How to make it800g tinned peach halves (2 tins)15g butter200g Greek yoghurt2 tbsp honey40g flaked almondsground cinnamon, to dustDrain the peaches and pat dry. Mix the yoghurt with the honey.Toast the almonds in a dry pan.Heat a griddle pan over high heat, brush with butter and grill the peaches cut side down until charred and caramelised.Serve warm with the yoghurt, almonds and a dusting of cinnamon.MainsPan-fried steakCut one for Sam, the best dog in New YorkHow to make it4 sirloin steaks50g butter2 garlic cloves, crushed1 bunch thymesalt and pepper, to tasteSeason the steaks well. Sear in a hot pan, turning once.Add the butter, garlic and thyme and baste.Rest the steaks, then slice. Keep a plain unseasoned piece aside for the dog.Central Park charred corn chicken bowlsFrom the corn he grows in the parkHow to make itAs written, serves 4Smoky grilled chicken thighs over rice with charred corn, black beans, chilli lime butter, parmesan, avocado and coriander.Toss 800g chicken thighs with 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, salt and oil.Grill 4 cobs of corn over hot coals for 10 minutes until charred, then grill the chicken 5 minutes a side.Cook 300g rice.Mix 40g soft butter with chilli flakes and lime zest.Cut the corn from the cobs and toss with the butter.Build bowls with rice, sliced chicken, corn, a drained 400g tin black beans, avocado, grated parmesan and coriander.SweetsNeville's shelter pantry rice puddingCreamy baked rice pudding with lemon peel and a nutmeg skin on top, made from what keeps in the pantry, served warm with jam.How to make it100g short grain rice60g caster sugar1 L full cream milk1 lemon1 whole nutmeg30g butter4 tbsp raspberry jamHeat the oven to 150°C and butter a baking dish.Stir the rice, sugar and milk together in the dish and add a long strip of lemon peel.Grate nutmeg over the top and dot with butter.Bake, stirring once after 30 minutes, until thick and creamy with a golden skin.Rest, then serve warm with a spoon of raspberry jam.DrinksLab bench bourbon peach smashBourbon muddled with tinned peach, lemon and mint, shaken hard and poured over crushed ice with a peach slice and mint sprig.How to make it410g tinned sliced peaches, drained (keep 60ml syrup)1 lemon10 mint leaves4 mint sprigs, to garnish200ml bourbon1 bag crushed ice2 cups ice, for shakingMuddle half the peach slices with the syrup, lemon juice and mint leaves in a shaker.Add the bourbon and ice and shake hard.Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice and garnish with a peach slice and a mint sprig.Moka pot espressoBrewed with Bob Marley on the stereo.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
